narrative.details:
Vartrus may offer you the stave to create a bow of Ancients but only I can enchant the string required to complete the bow.

It is a simple task, puny one. Slay a mature black dragon and remove the sinew from its bones. Return that sinew to me and I shall enchant the material into an almost indestructible bow string.
narrative.objectives: Stoma the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Black Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Stoma in Felwood.
narrative.offerRewardText:
A most foul dragon this one was. The sinew reeks of evil.

Give me a moment to cleanse the filth from this flesh and apply the proper enchantments.
narrative.requestItemsText: I am certain that you will have little difficulty in finding and slaying a black dragon, adventurer. Do not waste my time with idle chatter.
